description.value: Fossil Bay Resort is a small adult-only oceanfront cottage resort perched on the cliffs of the Juan de Fuca Strait near Shirley, roughly 55 km west of Victoria. Each self-contained cottage comes with a private hot tub, open fireplace, full kitchen, and large sundeck overlooking the water. The resort sits along West Coast Road amid beaches, hiking trails, and surf spots, making it a scenic base for exploring Vancouver Island's rugged south coast.

address.value: 11033 West Coast Road, Shirley, BC V9Z 1G9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about this adult-oriented oceanfront cottage resort. Wi-Fi and ethernet are explicitly listed as cottage amenities. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site. The website confirms the OSM address and provides phone/email not present in OSM tags. The community tag says 'Sooke' but the property is physically located in Shirley, BC per the website address.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Sooke' but the property address and website consistently show Shirley, BC — a distinct community roughly 15 km further west.
OSM record has no phone or email; phone (250-646-2073) and email (info@fossilbay.com) sourced from website.
Resort is adult-only and limits occupancy to 2 persons per cottage; not suitable for group cycling parties or families.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating accommodation with active 2025–2027 rate schedules and a functional booking process. A viable overnight stop for cyclists touring the Juan de Fuca corridor.

wow_evidence: adult-only oceanfront cottage resort perched on the cliffs of the Juan de Fuca Strait

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Nightly rates $279–$319 CAD before taxes; oceanfront cottages with premium amenities
